digital-employees.scene: ONE coherent digital-employee team application, not a collage. Narrow team roster at left with three small realistic professional headshot avatars (not robots), an employee role workspace in the center and a finished proposal document preview at right. Selected role visibly owns the assignment and its files. The document has real short headings and readable substantive paragraphs. The focus is a digital colleague turning a clear assignment into a usable proposal. No app-store grid of cards.

multi-agent.scene: ONE elegant task-orchestration application. Horizontal task workspace with one clear business assignment across top, three specialist execution lanes in the middle (source research, data extraction, risk review), and a unified completed report preview along bottom right. Fine purposeful connectors only between true task relationships. Each lane includes a short actual finding and a completion state, not empty boxes. Most visual area is legible work content. No sci-fi network, no abstract cubes, no giant glowing central node. The visual hierarchy shows one goal, specialist work, a combined result.

integrations.scene: ONE enterprise integration workbench. A slim connection list with MCP, RESTful API and database as genuine integration types. The MAIN work area is a real business task: read meeting notes, prepare customer follow-up, update an authorized customer record; show a compact request/result transaction log and a customer timeline with an actual substantive follow-up entry. A small separate OpenAPI tab belongs to external callers. Use blue, muted amber and mint only as small operational accents. Avoid floating logos or random floating cards. Make connection lead visibly to a business action and its record.

collaboration.scene: ONE premium enterprise project collaboration editor. A narrow file tree at left, a beautiful central readable project proposal/document, a thin vertical feedback conversation at right. Inline highlighted paragraph and one clear revision comment connect to the document, with two tiny human professional headshots and a digital employee role label. Bottom shows version comparison v1.2 to v1.3 and a finished document attachment. This must look like a UI designer could build it in Figma using standard 2D components: flat typography, dividers, list rows, real document text. No scattered document cards or translucent layers.

knowledge.scene: ONE enterprise knowledge search application. Large answer pane on the left and an opened policy source document on the right, slim library tree at far left. A relevant quoted source passage is highlighted in soft cyan, a small citation marker in the answer relates to it. The answer is a real short list of procurement-material requirements with specific source titles. Bottom contains a source list of 3 different meaningful documents, not skeleton lines. Strong editorial hierarchy and readable selected passage. No brain image, no glowing orb, no floating books.

governance.scene: ONE elegant enterprise access-and-audit console. Clear flat resource permission matrix on left two-thirds, focused audit event detail drawer at right. Permission matrix separates employee access, knowledge access, project role and business plugin delegation as DISTINCT rows. An authorization can be enabled or revoked, and a review snapshot is visible. Audit trail shows exact work steps linked to one resulting file. Refined navy, pale blue, tiny amber review indicators. No security shield illustration, lock floating in space, fake certification seals, or 3D objects. Business UI information is the main subject.
